items.quote:

items.quote: The government does not get to choose what’s best for our kids. Parents have every right to choose a faith-based curriculum for their children. I urge the Supreme Court to reverse the California court’s discriminatory decision. I will continue to defend homeschooling parents.

items.quote: My Stop Insider Trading Act would go beyond our current disclosure laws.

items.quote: I am also proud to represent our farmers and ranchers, who are the best in the world.

items.quote:
My INSULIN Act would deliver much-needed assistance to millions of Americans by capping insulin costs at $35 a month. 

With a bipartisan group of cosponsors spanning 21 states and counting, there is nationwide support for this bill, and I’m committed to getting it passed.
items.promise: Said she is committed to passing the INSULIN Act.

items.quote: And I oppose it because it would pose unnecessary and harmful obstacles to a woman's right--to all women's right to make our own decisions about our own reproductive health.
I urge my colleagues to oppose this legislation and its consideration on the Senate floor.
Madam President, I come to the floor today because I am concerned about President Trump's actions to, I believe, start a trade war with our top two trading partners, Canada and Mexico.
That is why I introduced the Protecting Americans from Tax Hikes on Imported Goods Act.
Passing my bill would give businesses and families more certainty to plan for the future and to keep more of their hard-earned dollars in their pockets.
President, I come to the floor to join my colleagues because I am so concerned about the damaging impact of President Trump's tariff taxes.

Proud to introduce my Health Care Affordability Act as my first bill of the 119th Congress. Families are already struggling to make ends meet and allowing the Affordable Care Act premium tax credits to expire would make health care costs skyrocket. Let’s get this done.
Congress must act now to extend the expiring health insurance tax credits, or else everyday Americans will be forced to foot the bill for skyrocketing health care costs.

I’ve never missed a vote.
 
I’ve voted for the SAVE America Act six times.
 
Any day we take a vote on SAVE is a day I will be in DC to vote yes.

items.quote:
I’ve always been for making it easier to vote and harder to cheat. I believe the SAVE Act is an important part of preserving the integrity of our elections. 

I’m proud to cosponsor this smart bill to make it harder to cheat at the ballot box.

Ohio is a model for what our elections should look like: easy to vote and hard to cheat.
 
That’s why I support the SAVE America Act. All Americans deserve to cast their vote with confidence in our election systems.
Mr. President, I rise today to speak about making life more affordable by lowering electricity prices through my bill, the Ratepayer Protection Act.
We need to protect American ratepayers from footing the bill.
In just a moment, I will ask for unanimous consent to pass my bill, S. 3391, the Accountability for Better Care Act.
My proposal represents a good-faith offer on a short-term basis to extend enhanced premium credits for 2 years.

If the U.S. is going to lead in digital assets, we need a framework that is clear, practical, and supports innovation and job creation here at home.

That’s why I support the CLARITY Act and will work to get it passed as soon as possible.

items.quote:
As I have said, I will not give away my vote to Trump to fund the government for nothing. 

A funding bill that continues to raise our costs, jeopardizes our health care, and hurts the people of my state does not have my support.
items.promise: Said he will not support a government funding bill that raises costs and jeopardizes health care.

items.quote:
As I've always said, I will not support a government funding bill that continues to raise our costs, jeopardizes our health care, and hurts the people of my state.

I’m urging my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to stand up for Americans who are counting on us to lower their costs, and address the urgent, and–in too many cases–dire challenges people are facing in our country. 

I will not let up in this fight.

I will vote no.
items.promise: Said he will vote no on a government funding bill that raises costs and jeopardizes health care.

items.quote: Kash Patel is dangerous, dishonest, and unqualified – I am calling for President Trump to withdraw his nomination to be the Director of the FBI, and if his nomination is brought to the Senate floor, I will vote NO. Here’s why 🧵
items.promise: Said he will vote no if Kash Patel's FBI Director nomination reaches the Senate floor.

items.quote: I support classwide scheduling for fentanyl analogues, but here we have this bill, the HALT bill, that my colleague pointed out did pass in a bipartisan way and now is in the Judiciary Committee.
I will not stop working until this body does more than just scheduling what has already been scheduled.
President, I want to speak forcefully against the Protect College Sports Act.
This bill does not do enough to protect college athletes' health and safety and well-being.

The passage of this bill, that does so much damage–just to give tax breaks to the ultra-wealthy–is a clear call for change in Washington.

I will continue to stand up and fight for working Americans across the country.

“The right to vote is precious, almost sacred. It is the most powerful nonviolent tool or instrument in a democratic society. We must use it.”

My good friend John Lewis was right. I will oppose the SAVE Act if it comes for a vote in the Senate.
items.promise: Said he will oppose the SAVE Act if it comes for a Senate vote.

items.quote: Kristi Noem and Donald Trump’s ICE is out of control and terrorizing our communities. With multiple deadly shootings of American citizens by federal agents in Minnesota and no accountability, I will not support an appropriations bill that funds DHS without real oversight, transparency, and consequences. President Trump, Kristi Noem, and Stephen Miller are making our communities and all Americans less safe. Enough is enough.
items.promise: Said he will not support a DHS appropriations bill without real oversight, transparency, and consequences.
